independenceStatement: This certification builds its own adversarial documents and its own direct calls into instrument-grouping.ts's groupPackageIntoInstruments - it does not re-run or re-read tests/foundation-audit/package-graph-adversarial.test.ts's own scenarios. Test file: tests/certification/section8-package-relationship-independent.test.ts (14 tests, all passing, executed this session).
scopeCovered: amendment vs supplement vs reference distinction (RELATIONSHIP_TYPES_BY_SOURCE_CLASSIFICATION)
P0-5 re-verification with an original adversarial construction
P1-7 isTrustedGroupingEdge re-verification with an original adversarial construction
real-data cross-check against the committed CONMED 4-document package

p0_5_reverification.construction: A synthetic 'Third Amendment to Credit Agreement' whose caption/operative body genuinely amends a real Credit Agreement (Doc B), but whose own WHEREAS recital additionally mentions, for cross-default context ONLY, a Guaranty and Security Agreement (Doc C) sharing the amendment's own execution date (April 4, 2024) - the exact coincidental type+date match shape P0-5 closes, built independently of the prior phase's own Indenture-based fixture (different agreement type, different contextual phrase, own dates/parties).
p0_5_reverification.result: Doc A -> Doc B resolves RESOLVED with STRONG_TARGET_EVIDENCE (from the caption's own operative naming). Doc A -> Doc C never reaches RESOLVED for any modification-type relationship - the exact recital reference resolves UNRESOLVED with evidenceClass CONTEXTUAL_MENTION_ONLY. instrument-grouping.ts correctly unions Doc A only with Doc B, never Doc C.
p0_5_reverification.positiveControlConstruction: A genuine two-target 'First Omnibus Amendment' whose operative body (post NOW, THEREFORE) explicitly amends BOTH a Credit Agreement and a separate Security Agreement, each with its own real 'hereby amended' tie - proves the evidence taxonomy discriminates by evidence rather than blanket-suppressing legitimate multi-target amendments.
p0_5_reverification.positiveControlResult: Both real targets resolve RESOLVED with STRONG_TARGET_EVIDENCE - no over-suppression.
p0_5_reverification.verdict: P0-5 FIX CONFIRMED GENUINE - re-derived independently, not merely re-read from the prior phase's own claim.

p1_7_reverification.construction: groupPackageIntoInstruments (instrument-grouping.ts) called directly with hand-constructed RelationshipCandidate arrays, including combinations relationship-resolution.ts's own current logic would never itself produce (a RESOLVED AMENDS edge carrying SUPPORTING_TARGET_EVIDENCE or CONTEXTUAL_MENTION_ONLY) - this is what makes it a genuine defense-in-depth test, not merely a re-confirmation of the upstream gate.
p1_7_reverification.result: A genuinely trusted RESOLVED+STRONG_TARGET_EVIDENCE edge unions its documents (positive control). A RESOLVED edge carrying SUPPORTING_TARGET_EVIDENCE or CONTEXTUAL_MENTION_ONLY is NEVER trusted for grouping, even though it is impossible for today's relationship-resolution.ts to actually emit that combination - isTrustedGroupingEdge's own check fires independently. The backward-compatible 'no evidenceClass field at all' default remains trusted, as documented.
p1_7_reverification.verdict: P1-7 CONFIRMED - real, working defense-in-depth, not merely a coincidental byproduct of the upstream fix.

realDataCrossCheck.package: CONMED 4-document real fixture (tests/fixtures/unseen-packages/conmed-2025-credit-facility/curated/) - deterministic, $0 cost, real fixture text run through the real, unmodified buildPackageGraph.
findings: No relationship candidate in the real package reaches RESOLVED for a modification-type relationship with anything less than STRONG_TARGET_EVIDENCE.
The real 2026 First Omnibus Amendment (naming the Eighth A&R Credit Agreement present in this package, matching execution date) correctly resolves RESOLVED and groups into the base instrument.

REAL, CORRECT, CONSERVATIVE BEHAVIOR (Architecture Invariant #11): the real 2022 Second Amendment's own text names the SEVENTH Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (dated July 16, 2021) - a document this specific 4-document package does not itself contain (only the Eighth A&R, a later restatement, is present). The system correctly leaves this REVIEW_REQUIRED (type matches, execution date does not) rather than assuming the Eighth A&R is 'close enough' by recency/convenience - this amendment is correctly NOT auto-grouped without human confirmation of the restatement lineage. This was independently discovered during this certification (not previously documented as a specific real-data behavior) and is CORRECT, not a defect.
The Guarantee and Collateral Agreement is never folded into the credit-agreement instrument's own document set (non-instrument type, correctly excluded from grouping).

newFindingsThisSession.title: document-classifier.ts's self-referential-title priority defense only protects documents that actually use the '(this "Amendment")' drafting convention
newFindingsThisSession.description: Independently constructed: an amendment with NO early self-referential parenthetical, whose own caption mentions a 'Security Agreement' target BEFORE any Amendment-specific self-identifying language reaches the fixed-priority RULES array (SECURITY_AGREEMENT is checked before AMENDMENT in document-classifier.ts's own RULES list), is misclassified as SECURITY_AGREEMENT rather than AMENDMENT. Downstream, its relationship candidates against the real Credit Agreement are typed SECURES rather than AMENDS.
newFindingsThisSession.disposition: This is a disclosed-boundary limitation, not a silent regression: document-classifier.ts's own header comment states the fallback path is 'the original broad preamble scan - UNCHANGED' when no self-referential term is found. This finding quantifies exactly which real drafting shape (a document lacking the self-referential-title convention, referencing a different real agreement type earlier in its own preamble) still trips the pre-existing fallback bug the fix's own coverage does not extend to. Not fixed (frozen production code); flagged for a future phase.
newFindingsThisSession.regressionTest: tests/certification/section8-package-relationship-independent.test.ts, describe block 'Section 8 REAL FINDING (disclosed-boundary, not a regression)'

verdictRationale: P0-5 and P1-7 both independently re-verified with original adversarial constructions, distinct from the prior phase's own fixtures, and both hold. Real CONMED package cross-check confirms no false-confident AMENDS edges and correct conservative (REVIEW_REQUIRED, not guessed) handling of a genuine cross-restatement-lineage ambiguity. One MINOR, disclosed-boundary classification gap found and documented - does not rise to MAJOR/BLOCKER since it is a known, bounded V1 limitation (never silently claimed complete) and does not create cross-instrument contamination (a misclassified document is typed SECURES, still correctly excluded from instrument grouping, never wrongly unioned).
